house_style: Bright, fresh modern illustration like a well-designed cookbook for middle schoolers: clean confident shapes, soft painted texture, appetizing natural colors, gentle shading. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border, no frame.

assets.name: bar
assets.prompt: Empty background: a sunny smoothie bar seen straight on at counter height. A light wooden counter along the bottom, behind it a mint-green tiled wall, open shelves with plants and glass jars, a big window with morning light on one side. The middle of the counter is empty. No blender, no fruit on the counter, no people, no writing, no menu board. 16:9.
